reason_for_pre_response_refinement: R3 already represents direct Euclidean occupied-source distance and pressure, whereas C adds graph-path source terms. The mechanism moderator should therefore measure heterogeneity in topology beyond Euclidean source geometry rather than heterogeneity in raw graph access that partially duplicates R3.

topology_residual_definition.d_euclid: great-circle distance between target i and possible source j
topology_residual_definition.d_graph: shortest-path distance on the frozen actual k=3 source graph
topology_residual_definition.interpretation: q_ij=1 when graph path adds no detour beyond direct distance; smaller values mean topology reduces source accessibility beyond Euclidean R3
topology_residual_definition.H_topo_i: population variance(q_ij) / mean(q_ij)^2 across the six possible pilot sources
topology_residual_definition.n_six_rule: scarcity factor is zero; exclude from primary mechanism species universe

response_free_support_audit.role: establish whether the independent boreal geography contains enough topology-residual heterogeneity to test the mechanism before bird response access
response_free_support_audit.required_condition: H_topo_i must be nonconstant across the thirteen confirmatory targets

null_ensemble.raw_graph_S_surface_role: historical response-free diagnostic only; may not define the primary moderator after v1.162

pilot_gate.species_rule: retain species with 1 to 5 occupied pilot islands

primary_scoring.primary_moderator: z-score of log1p(S_topo_i(n_s)) over the complete eligible confirmatory prediction surface, frozen after pilot but before confirmatory response
primary_scoring.within_block_statistic: OLS slope of D_is on the frozen moderator among realized presence cells
primary_scoring.estimand: equal-weight mean of estimable confirmatory-block slopes
primary_scoring.bootstrap: 10000 deterministic replicates over estimable confirmatory blocks
primary_scoring.support_rule: point estimate < 0 and 95% bootstrap upper bound < 0

secondary_nonrescuing: descriptive results by pilot occupancy n
next_action: freeze a response-independent target-by-n S_topo surface and verify nonconstant H_topo before any bird pilot access
